title: Live channel updates in the chat UI
description: Ryan 11-02: when someone has the Chatticus chat UI open and is engaged in a conversation, it updates in real time, including messages from other people. Today the only stream is per turn (/turns/:id/stream). Other readers, such as forum lists, may be slower and poll. Done: Gherkin scenarios for a second person's message appearing in an open chat, reconnect, and removal from the channel ending the stream. Depends on the channel record.
